  "skill2": "feat(renderers): name loaded skills and mark skill references

When a call finishes, the tool matches the files of returned reads against
the skills Pi loaded and records them in details.skillFiles. Renderers use
that record to name skills as Pi lists them and to show reads of other files
in a skill's directory as `[skill ref]`, such as
`[skill] code-review ⚠ partial: lines 1-10 of 30 + references/guide.md`.
Results without the record keep the SKILL.md rule.

ux.manageSession gains a `skills` option for loading skills in the isolated
Pi, and a `skill-ref` fixture exercises references.

feat(renderers): mark returned skill-file reads like Pi's [skill] line

A returned workspace read of a SKILL.md is headed by its skill, such as
`[skill] pit-delivery, 1-176 of 176, raw`, instead of its path. Skill reads
returned in a batch, array, or object get one `[skill] name` row each, with a
partial-coverage warning when their reads miss lines of the file.

Adds `skill` and `skill-return` UX fixtures.
